title: Nagorno-Karabakh refugees rally for expanded government aid and return guarantees
organizer: Karabakh civic organizations and public figures; the article says they emphasized the rally’s nonpartisan character
threshold_50_evidence: A contemporaneous Azatutyun/RFE-RL article directly reports hundreds of refugees demonstrating in Yerevan. This is clear qualitative evidence above 50; no exact count is assigned.

title.summary: Contemporaneous report calls this a rally by Karabakh refugees in Yerevan.

start_date.summary: Article and image caption date the gathering to Wednesday, 20 March 2024.

end_date.summary: The article describes a rally on 20 March but does not establish its physical end; end date unknown.

location.summary: Article caption places the rally in Liberty Square, Yerevan.

scope.summary: The source describes one Yerevan rally; national organization or simultaneous sites are not claimed.

organizer.summary: Karabakh civic organizations and public figures organized the rally and emphasized its nonpartisan character.

demands.summary: Demands targeted Armenia’s government: expand aid, raise housing support without repayment, continue rent/utility compensation, and seek international security guarantees for return. Political_behavior_process is a provisional category for domestic government subsidy/policy choices.

participants_original.summary: The source says “hundreds of refugees”; text retained without converting to an exact estimate.

participants_min.summary: No explicit numeric minimum is reported; null.

participants_max.summary: No explicit numeric maximum is reported; null.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The source’s “hundreds” description clearly exceeds 50 qualitatively.

protester_violence.summary: The article does not report whether protesters used violence; unknown.

state_response.summary: The article does not report a response to this gathering; all seven response values remain unknown.

episode_key.summary: S001 and search-only leads S003/S004 refer to reporting around the 20 March rally; no additional gathering or continuous episode established.

notes: The body of one contemporaneous local report was opened and read. A photograph-caption search result and a 27 March context article surfaced but remain search-only and are not used as independent corroboration. Article mentions an aid/housing plan and demands; figures about that plan are policy context, not protester counts. Captured Aravot.am (S005) and Oragark (S006) search results also refer to a rally statement and housing-funding demands. They remain search-only; possible republication/shared origin is unresolved, so they are not counted as independent corroboration or used to add field values.
open_questions: Find independent contemporary coverage or organizer records.
Determine response by Armenian authorities and whether protesters used violence; current article is silent.
Follow up whether further public rallies were part of the same campaign or distinct actions; no continuation is confirmed by this search pass.
Clarify the category mapping for refugee housing and return-security demands at human review.
Identify the written origin and independence of the Aravot.am and Oragark search-only reports before treating them as separate coverage.
